concerns.text: FR-001 (download GSM8K and MiniGrid, cap at 500 examples) has no dedicated task. T010 only downloads GSM8K and lacks MiniGrid logic, and no task enforces the 500‑example cap.
FR-002 (baseline generation & ground‑truth labeling) is not covered by any concrete task. Tasks T013‑T019 are merely mentioned as “remain checked” and provide no implementation or verification steps.

FR-003 (capture per‑layer probability distributions and compute Shannon entropy) lacks an explicit task. T022‑T027 are referenced but not defined, and T007a only implements a helper without a task to apply it across layers.
FR-004 (fit logistic regression / GLMM) is not mapped to any task. Phase 5 tasks T030a‑T036 are only noted as “remain checked” and do not specify model fitting, reporting, or validation.
FR-005 (sensitivity‑analysis threshold sweep) has no associated task. The referenced T030a‑T036 block does not enumerate a sweep routine or reporting step.
FR-006 (multiple‑comparison correction) is uncovered by any task. No task in Phase 5 or elsewhere mentions Bonferroni/BH correction.
FR-007 (process extraction in 50‑token batches) is not satisfied. T009’s `stream_batch` does not enforce the 50‑token limit nor raise the required exceptions, and no test validates this behavior.
SC-001 (measure correlation coefficient) lacks a task to compute or record the log‑odds coefficient.
SC-002 (measure AUC‑ROC) is not linked to any task; no task computes or validates AUC.
SC-003 (report optimal entropy threshold) has no dedicated task; the threshold optimization is only implied in Phase 5 without concrete implementation.
SC-004 (measure decay of predictive power across sequence lengths / task types) is not covered by any task.
SC-005 (produce FDR report after multiple‑comparison correction) is missing; no task generates the required FDR JSON.
User Story 1 downstream tasks T013‑T019 are referenced as “remain checked” but are not enumerated as concrete tasks; the plan therefore lacks actionable items for baseline generation and labeling.
User Story 2 downstream tasks T022‑T027 are only mentioned as “remain checked” without concrete task definitions, leaving entropy extraction uncovered.
User Story 3 downstream tasks T030a‑T036 are not listed as explicit tasks; statistical analysis, threshold optimization, and reporting are absent.
Polish & cross‑cutting concerns (T040‑T046) are not defined; README, API docs, linting, CLI, and quick‑start validation lack concrete tasks.
Data integrity & execution safety tasks (T047‑T056) are only noted as “remain checked” with no explicit task entries.
No task explicitly creates or validates the `TokenSequence` artifact; while T008 provides generic validators, there is no dedicated task to generate the sequence records.
No task explicitly produces `EntropyProfile` records per the contract; T007a implements a helper but no task ties it to the per‑layer extraction pipeline.
No task explicitly creates a `RegressionModel` artifact conforming to its schema; the analysis phase lacks a concrete task to output this model.
The quick‑start guide is listed in the project structure but no task references its creation, verification, or testing.
Tasks T001a and T001b claim to define Semantic Alignment logic, but no task verifies that the contracts are actually authored or validated against the schema.
The required `requirements.txt` file does not exist at the declared path, violating Constitution Principle I and leaving the reproducibility requirement uncovered.
The `pyproject.toml`, `ruff.toml`, and `.black.toml` files are missing or empty, breaching reproducibility and version‑discipline.
The download script is placed under `code/src/data/download.py` instead of the required `projects/.../code/src/data/download.py`, and it only handles GSM8K; MiniGrid download logic is absent.
`data/canonical_ground_truth.jsonl` is missing, preventing ground‑truth labeling and violating Constitution Principle VII.
